title: 壁付業務用レンジフード
description: 厨房の加熱器具上に配置する壁付排気フード。内側が開いた斜面キャノピーと角形煙道、二枚の実隙間付きバッフルフィルター、引手、下面照明の外形、前面ボタン、背面取付スロットと小さな回収カップを造形。床基準原点から設置高さを調整し、建物ダクトは別途配置します。送風・照明・捕集機能は実装していません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.200 × 0.926 × 0.665 m、6,272三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A wall-mounted extraction hood for placement above cooking equipment, with hollow sloped canopy and rectangular chimney, two genuinely gapped baffle filters, pulls, underside-light exteriors, front buttons, rear mounting slots and a small collection cup. Adjust installation height from the base origin; building ductwork is separate. Air movement, lighting and capture functions are not implemented. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.200 × 0.926 × 0.665 m; 6,272 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
